newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Revoz top Slovenian exporter in 96 - weekly.
newsitem.headline: Revoz top Slovenian exporter in 96 - weekly.

text.p: Slovenian car producer Revoz, a subsidiary of France's Renault, was the country's top exporter in 1996, business weekly Gospodarski Vestnik said on Friday.
Revoz, the leading exporter for the third year in a row, was followed by household appliances producer Gorenje, which was also second in 1995, and drug makers Krka and Lek.

Revoz, which is 54 percent owned by French Renault and 46 percent by the Slovenian state, increased exports by 23 percent to 104.5 billion tolars ($667 million) but said it expected exports to ease to 98.2 billion in 1997.

Among the top four exporters Krka achieved the biggest growth in exports, raising them by 29.5 percent to 29.47 billion tolars mainly due to higher exports to eastern European countries. Krka said it expected its exports to rise to 33.5 billion in 1997.
Lek's exports were up 17.4 percent to 27.4 billion tolars and the company expects them to grow to 32.1 billion this year.

Gorenje's exports rose 23.2 percent to 41.4 billion tolars. The company aims for exports to rise to 43.3 billion in 1997. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439 ($ = 156.6 Slovenian Tolars)
